item.description: The HTTP2RecordRequest and HTTP2RecordResponse classes have incomplete implementations for HTTP/2 protocol specifics. The method, uri, status_code, and message properties are returning placeholders instead of properly parsing HTTP/2 pseudo-headers.
item.contract: Update HTTP2RecordRequest and HTTP2RecordResponse classes to properly parse HTTP/2 pseudo-headers from the wire data. The method property should extract the :method pseudo-header, uri should extract the :path and :authority pseudo-headers, status_code should extract the :status pseudo-header, and message should extract the appropriate reason phrase.
